Notification Release Date18 Oct 2026
Online Registration Start DateActive Now (Official Portal)

Admit Card / Exam DateAnnounced Soon on Official Portal

💳 2. Application Fee Structure & Payment Modes

  • General / OBC / EWS Male Candidates: As per Board Notification rules (Usually ₹100/- to ₹500/-).
  • SC / ST / Divyang (PwD) Candidates: ₹0/- (Nil / Exempted as per government norms).
  • Payment Options: Online mode through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe).

🎂 3. Age Limit Criteria & Relaxation

Minimum Age Requirement18 Years (Post anusar)
Maximum Age Limit27 - 40 Years (Post wise criteria)

🎓 4. Vacancy Details & Educational Eligibility

  • 10th / 12th Pass Posts: Manyataprapta Board se 10th (Matric) ya 12th (Intermediate) pass.
  • Degree / Diploma Posts: Relevant field mein Bachelor Degree / Diploma / ITI (Official PDF dekhein).

⚙️ 5. Stage-by-Stage Selection Process

  1. Stage 1: Computer Based Written Exam (CBT / OMR Objective Test).
  2. Stage 2: Skill Test / Typing Test / PET (Jahan laagu ho).
  3. Stage 3: Document Verification (Mool praman patron ki janch).
  4. Stage 4: Medical Examination (Swasthya parikshan).

📚 6. Exam Pattern & Subject-Wise Syllabus

  • Reasoning: Puzzles, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Series, Syllogism.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Percentage, Ratio, Profit & Loss, Speed Math, Data Interpretation.
  • General Awareness: Pichhle 6 mahine ka Current Affairs, Samvidhan, Geography, History.
  • Language: Grammar, Error Spotting, Reading Comprehension, Vocabulary.

🎯 7. Aakhri 1 Mahine Ki Preparation Strategy (30 Days Blueprint)

  • Week 1 (Concept Revision): Short notes aur math formulas ko thoroughly revise karein.
  • Week 2 (Sectional Practice): Weak subjects par time-bound sectional tests lagayein.
  • Week 3 (Full Mock Routine): Pariksha ke exact time-slot par rojana 1 poora Full Mock Test lagayein.
  • Week 4 (Previous Year Papers): Pichhle 5 saalon ke actual papers solve karein aur calm mind se revise karein.
